examples.label: Evaluate expressions
examples.purpose: Each rule computes the value $$ of its left side from $1, $2, … of its right side when the parser reduces: a node's value is known as it is built.

examples.label: Three-address code (quadruples)
examples.purpose: Every operator gets a fresh temporary; emit appends a quadruple (operator, two arguments, result). The order of the quadruples is the order of the reductions.
examples.text:
<expr> → <expr> '+' <term> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('+', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <expr> '-' <term> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('-', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <term>
<term> → <term> '*' <factor> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('*', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <term> '/' <factor> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('/', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <factor>
<factor> → '(' <expr> ')' {{ $$.place = $2.place }}
  | num {{ $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | id {{ $$.place = $1.lexeme }}

examples.label: Translation to postfix
examples.purpose: A translation into a string: the value of a node is the postfix text of its subtree.
